remaining_gaps: First end not established from held sources. Held evidence bounds it only: EO 13062 (1997-09-29) states in its text that the committees it revokes 'have terminated and whose work is completed' (section 3), effective 1997-09-30; Section 4 of EO 12964 ends under section 4 thirty or sixty days after the final report, and no held source dates that report (searched the held corpus by order number and by commission name, including jobs/selden-fr-citers). Missing source: the Commission's final report or transmittal with its submission date (or a presidential or agency statement of the date the Commission terminated). A revocation date is the formal disposition, not by default the first end (owner ruling 2026-10-28).
